name: vitest-workspace-file-by-version
description: Vitest's workspace file is read through its convention row: where the installed Vitest is 3.2 or later before 4, vitest.workspace.ts is an entry and the setup files of each inline project it lists are test files, while a package that declares no Vitest enters no workspace file. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named vitest for the package vitest from 3.2.0 up to 4.0.0 that roots vitest.workspace.ts and reads setupFiles from each inline project of its default export.
